achievements.name: First Chapter
achievements.detail: Finish the opening chapter of any traveler's story.

achievements.name: Full Story
achievements.detail: Complete all four chapters of a single traveler's tale.

achievements.name: Eight Travelers
achievements.detail: Recruit all eight travelers into your party.

achievements.name: Break and Boost
achievements.detail: Break an enemy by removing its shields, then spend Boost points on an action in that same battle.

achievements.name: Path Actions
achievements.detail: Use the path actions of four different travelers.

achievements.name: Travel Banter
achievements.detail: Watch a travel banter between two party members.

achievements.name: Side Story
achievements.detail: Finish a side story accepted from someone in town.

achievements.name: Secondary Job
achievements.detail: Learn a secondary job at a shrine and equip it on a traveler.

achievements.name: Advanced Jobs
achievements.detail: Unlock the Runelord, Sorcerer, Warmaster, and Starseer jobs.

achievements.name: Battle-Tested
achievements.detail: Win a Battle-Tested weapon from the person who carries it.

achievements.name: All Stories
achievements.detail: Finish the fourth chapter of every traveler.

achievements.name: Final Gate
achievements.detail: Clear the optional dungeon that opens once all eight stories are finished.
